# CLOUVA

Official artist profile: https://clouva.com.ar/clouva

CLOUVA is an Argentine musical artist from Zapala, Neuquén, Argentina, with roots in La 180.

Names used by the artist:
- CLOUVA
- Clouva
- Clover
- Clover.nlb

Official profiles:
- Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/4ZcY2ix70hKrXgP6QlnZhT
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@clouvanlb

The Spotify artist profile currently appears as Clover.

Artist concept: Vida de Flows.

Current biography, music, videos, connected studios and official links are published at:
https://clouva.com.ar/clouva
